Save & Restore Data
Export all farm data (lines, stations, flowering, harvest, operations) as a single file, then upload it to the farm folder on Drive or OneDrive. To restore it later, use "Import backup" and pick the same file.
🔀 "Merge backup": adds the other device's data to yours without deleting anything (best for combining data from several workers). ⬆️ "Import & replace": wipes this device's data and fully replaces it with the imported file.
📗
Google Sheets Sync
Connect your Google Sheets script URL once, then upload your data or pull another device's data with one tap — automatic, no files.
✅ Uploaded successfully — 8/22/2026, 10:19:30 AM
1️⃣ Open Google Sheets and create a new blank file.<br> 2️⃣ From the menu: Extensions → Apps Script.<br> 3️⃣ Delete the existing code and paste the code given to you by the developer.<br> 4️⃣ Click Deploy → New deployment → Web app.<br> 5️⃣ Set access to "Anyone", then deploy and copy the resulting URL.<br> 6️⃣ Paste the URL in the field above.

Planting Stations

Each line is divided into stations, and each station holds two facing pits, A and B (the mother tree and its sucker). Pick a line to view its stations and update each pit's status, seedling count, sucker count, flowering date, and notes. Harvests are recorded in the Harvest section only. Don't forget to press "Save station changes" when done.
